headline: Quantum Many-Body Physics, Complexity, and Scaled Solvers
summary: Today's selection ranges from experimental quantum simulations of quasiparticle scattering to classical GPU solvers for massive quantum subspaces. Theoretical advances also resolve graph query complexities and explore fundamental modifications to measurement rules and fermionic states.

themes.title: Quantum Many-Body Simulation & States
themes.body: Studies explore many-body dynamics directly on hardware and in theory, demonstrating a 42-qubit quasiparticle collider and classifying maximally antiflat fermionic states under fixed particle numbers.

themes.title: Foundations & Algorithm Complexity
themes.body: Theoretical works tackle foundational measurement mechanics by warping the Born rule and resolve tight quantum query complexity bounds for graph degree and cut problems.

themes.title: Quantum Computing Implementations & Tools
themes.body: Practical quantum workflows advance through JAX-based GPU eigensolvers capable of handling 2³⁰-dimensional subspaces and 172-qubit hybrid annealing networks for real-world environmental nowcasting.

connections.body: Both 2610.13946 and 2610.13903 investigate strongly correlated fermionic systems, examining non-Gaussian correlations and quasiparticle entanglement across fixed-particle-number states.
